character: Rameses Najeer's sacrifice, riddle, escape, and Dagger confrontation
voice: Educated, exact, and ominously ceremonial without a written lisp; Laura's correct objection separates ancient Egyptian history from the modern society's invented rite.

entries.text: You don't really intend to kill me, do you?
Of course not.
Whew! What a relief.
Kill is such an ugly word. You are to be sacrificed to Amon Ra.
Can we discuss this?
There is nothing to discuss. You should be honored to serve so distinguished a purpose.
In our society's rites, the chosen once fought for such a privilege.
Wait. Ancient Egyptians did not practice human sacrifice!
Quite right. You know something of ancient Egyptian history, Miss Bow.
I've learned a few things.
Perhaps we should test the extent of that knowledge.
Do I have any other choice?
You may submit to a test or to the ceremony. The choice is yours.
I'm beginning to like this idea. What sort of test?
Amon Ra may yet intervene on your behalf. Our rules require us to spare anyone who can answer his riddle.
Wonderful.
You must answer the riddle in hieroglyphs.
I was afraid it would be something like that. All right, what's the riddle?
It has two parts.
What is the room you leave without entering?
I regret that you are wrong. It seems Amon Ra has chosen you for the ceremony.
No! Wait! Mmmph! Mmmph!
Correct. Now the second riddle: What is the room you enter without leaving?
Most impressive. No one before you has solved it. Amon Ra evidently commands us to spare you. Will you swear never to reveal this place?
Of course!
Then you may go. May Amon Ra guide your steps.
Thank you! Now I only have to outrun the person chasing me.
Who is pursuing you? Do you believe they will find this chamber?
I'm not sure who it is, but I believe it's the person who stole the Dagger of Amon Ra. And I'm certain they'll find their way in here.
If that is true, they will not leave this chamber alive. Take the hidden passage behind the altar. Go--and remember your oath!
Does this look familiar?
It is... the Dagger of Amon Ra!
That's right. I--
You are the thief! You will answer to Amon Ra!
Wait! You don't understand! I--
Your death will be slow and painful, blasphemer!
Mmmph! Mmmph!
